target_pattern: Use high-frequency Spanish verb plus preposition chunks as fixed patterns, including meaning shifts with pensar and pronominal constructions like quejarse de and enamorarse de.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Choosing prepositions by literal English translation.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Many Spanish verbs require specific prepositions as part of one chunk. Changing the preposition can change meaning or sound non-native.
target_pattern_formula: sonar con plus noun or infinitive
pensar plus infinitive for plans, pensar en for mental focus, pensar de for opinion
pronominal chunks: enamorarse de, despedirse de, cansarse de, burlarse de, quejarse de
action chunks: invitar a, aprender a, ensenar a, empezar a, ayudar a, limitarse a
support and dependence chunks: contar con, depender de, acostumbrarse a, abusar de
natural_examples: Sueno con vivir cerca del mar.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Sueno con vivir en la playa. -> change location to la montana.
Base: Pensamos mudarnos a Mexico. -> change subject to singular yo.
Base: Siempre pienso en ti. -> change pronoun to plural ustedes.
Base: Que piensas del nuevo supervisor? -> change noun to nuevo horario.
Base: Maria se enamoro de Julio. -> change object to su mejor amigo.
Base: Mi primo se despidio de nosotros. -> change pronoun to singular mi.
Base: Juan se canso de trabajar. -> change infinitive to esperar.
Base: Los estudiantes se burlan del profesor. -> change to singular subject el estudiante.
Base: Me limito a beber dos copas. -> change infinitive to comer postre.
Base: Mi primo me invito a cenar. -> change infinitive to almorzar.
Base: Aprendi a nadar a los cinco anos. -> change skill to conducir.
Base: Mi padre me enseno a cocinar. -> change teacher to mi madre and skill coser.
Base: Vamos a empezar a pintar la casa. -> change verb pintar to limpiar.
Base: Siempre puedes contar conmigo. -> change pronoun to plural nosotros.
Base: La duracion del viaje depende del trafico. -> change noun phrase to el costo.

prompts: I dream of being a lawyer. (Sueno con ser abogado. vs Sueno de ser abogado.)
We plan to travel. (Pensamos viajar. vs Pensamos en viajar.)
I think about my family. (Pienso en mi familia. vs Pienso de mi familia.)
What do you think of the plan? (Que piensas del plan? vs Que piensas en el plan?)
She fell in love with him. (Se enamoro de el. vs Se enamoro con el.)
He said goodbye to me. (Se despidio de mi. vs Se despidio con mi.)
We started to study. (Empezamos a estudiar. vs Empezamos de estudiar.)
Can I count on you? (Puedo contar contigo? vs Puedo contar en ti?)
It depends on the weather. (Depende del clima. vs Depende en el clima.)
She complains about everything. (Se queja de todo. vs Se queja con todo.)

common_errors.mistake: Preposition chosen from literal English pattern
common_errors.correct_spanish: Memorize verb and preposition as one chunk.

common_errors.mistake: Sonar de used for dream of
Pensar en used for planning actions
common_errors.why_it_happens: Meanings of pensar constructions are not separated.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use pensar plus infinitive for plans.

common_errors.mistake: Pensar de used for think about
common_errors.why_it_happens: Opinion and mental focus meanings are mixed.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use pensar en for think about.

common_errors.mistake: Reflexive pronoun dropped in pronominal chunks
common_errors.correct_spanish: Keep forms like quejarse de and enamorarse de.

common_errors.mistake: Contar en used for rely on

common_errors.correct_spanish: Use del where required by noun phrase.
Use despedirse de for saying goodbye.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Chunk meaning not reinforced in usage.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Practice each pair in complete adult-life sentences.
